title: Wrong IP Configuration
description: A computer cannot communicate after a manual IP change.
options: Incorrect IP address or subnet mask
explanation: An invalid IP address or subnet mask can prevent correct local network communication.

title: VLAN Mismatch
description: Two devices on different switch ports cannot communicate although their IP settings appear correct.
options: Ports are assigned to incompatible VLANs
explanation: Devices in different VLANs require appropriate Layer 3 routing to communicate.

title: DNS Failure
description: A user can access a website by IP address but not by domain name.
explanation: Successful IP access with failed domain-name access commonly indicates a DNS issue.

title: Routing Failure
description: A workstation reaches its gateway but cannot reach another network.
explanation: A routing problem can prevent traffic from reaching a remote network.

title: Subnet Configuration
description: Two hosts cannot communicate after one receives a new subnet mask.
explanation: An incorrect subnet mask can cause hosts to calculate network membership incorrectly.
